name: As Long As It's Not Illegal
source:
It's your last three days as a senior at Suncity high.

As your senior prank, you, along with the group of Senior elites, decide to use your influence to host a party amongst your class in the most illegal way.

[From [URL=https://mcxcheri.itch.io/as-long-as-its-not-illegal]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
這是你在太陽城高中畢業前的最後三天。

為了搞一次畢業惡作劇，你和一群應屆畢業生裡的風雲人物決定利用自己的影響力，為全班辦一場儘可能違法的派對。

[摘自[URL=https://mcxcheri.itch.io/as-long-as-its-not-illegal]itch.io[/URL]]
